subject: Startups
title: The Dark Pattern Epidemic
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Dark Pattern Epidemic.

hook.text: LinkedIn used to send emails to your entire contact list without clear consent. Millions felt tricked.

buildup.text: Dark patterns are design tricks that manipulate users: hidden unsubscribe buttons, confusing opt-outs, forced sharing.

discovery.text: Growth teams under pressure resort to tricks. A/B tests show dark patterns boost numbers. Ethics gets sidelined.

twist.text: Short-term gains backfire. Users lose trust, regulators notice, and lawsuits follow.

climax.text: The EU's GDPR and California's CCPA now explicitly target dark patterns. What once boosted metrics now brings fines.

punchline.text: Dark patterns grow numbers but destroy trust.

quiz.question: What happened to LinkedIn over its aggressive contact import feature?
options: It faced a $13 million lawsuit settlement
